subject: sub-04
split: Use only the 416 generic fit classes to train the reversal rule. Reserve the historical 96-class development split for one evaluation under the original twelve-candidate menu, supports, same session pairs and four physical presentations. The historical baseline of 514/960 was already public. No target panels enter this study.
training: Divide the 416 objects into two recording-pair-stratified groups. Refit the original 750-update neural encoder and Fisher projection independently on the other group to form each calibration group's scores, representations and same-session twelve-object menus. Each object supplies ten distinct held-photo queries against eight other support photos. Train a ridge-logistic pair rule on its out-of-class evidence. Fix regularization C=0.1 with standardized features. Rows with neither finalist correct have zero payoff for either choice and do not train the conditional logistic loss.
representations: Use both historical standardized base-score gaps, plus differences between runner and leader using four single trials, all six two-trial subsets and their complementary support views, early vs late cross-session evidence, and support dispersion and rank consistency from the eight independent support photographs. No additional physical repetitions. Positive orientation favors the original runner.
decision: Cross-fit the logistic rule over four object groups inside the 416 calibration objects. Choose the cutoff from 0.50, 0.55, 0.60, 0.65, 0.70 or never flip to maximize all-query net corrections, breaking ties toward fewer flips. Freeze before evaluating the held 96. Fixed secondary: average the Fisher, full-encoder and complementary-pair standardized evidence equally and re-rank only the original two.
control: Keep both finalists, their base Fisher and deep scores, and their original eight support photos. Exchange only the extra per-trial query views with a different held photo from another candidate in the same source menu, using the archived cyclic candidate permutation. Apply the same fit and cutoff. Report corrections, newly wrong choices and wrong-to-wrong changes.
gate: Before any new target inference or generation, the primary must add at least ten correct decisions per 960 and the paired 95% whole-object bootstrap lower bounds must exceed zero against both the original mixture and the exchanged-extra-evidence control. A positive generic result authorizes separate target-category and generated-image tests.
intervals: Resample 96 whole truth objects, preserving their ten photographs and paired methods. 10000 percentile bootstrap replicates, seed 260625. Intervals describe this single participant and the frozen menus.
